- Download videos embedded in web pages: paste the page link (e.g. a course page with its own player) and the app finds the stream (m3u8/mpd/mp4 or known player iframe)
- Optional hidden-browser search for JavaScript players (requires Playwright, not included in the GUI builds)
- Page is sent as Referer, file is named after the page title
- GUI: new Browser-Login choice for pages that require your login
- CLI: new --cookies (cookies.txt) and --referer options
- Clear messages for DRM-protected videos and pages without a video
